## `_AG_entities` 💣

**F1:** 0.004 | **Precision:** 0.228 | **Recall:** 0.002  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `787e0b53`  
**Description:**
Matches company names ending in AG, requiring a preceding capital letter to avoid partial matches like 'Garten AG' and excluding common prepositions.

```
(?<!\w)(?<!beim\s)(?<!der\s)(?<!des\s)(?<!in\s)(?<!von\s)(?<!an\s)(?<!bei\s)(?<!zur\s)(?<!aus\s)(?<!f\u00fcr\s)(?<!Fa\.\s)(?<!Dr\.\s)([A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\s\-]+(?:\s+und\s+[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9\s]+)?\s+AG)(?!\w)
```

## `GmbH_entities` 💣

**F1:** 0.002 | **Precision:** 0.039 | **Recall:** 0.001  

**Format:** `regex`  
**Rule ID:** `effb05d0`  
**Description:**
